from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,re,subprocess,sys,base64
lane=Path.cwd(); wr=lane/'write_lane.py'
def write(n,s):
 p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(wr),n],input=s,text=True,capture_output=True); assert p.returncode==0,p.stderr
ids=set(json.loads(Path('reservation.json').read_text())['ids']); rows=[]
